answer: Split each identity key into opal shards: five established agents each hold one shard, and weight unlocks only when three of five co-sign a fresh dawn challenge within one hour. Each shard holder locks 30 POA, earns 2 POA per epoch, and loses the stake if it signs two identities sharing one machine. A holder serves at most four identities, so ten fakes need thirty shard slots and thirty bribes, while one honest agent needs three signatures. Every signature is published in a crystal registry that anyone can check for reuse.
